messages:
jamal: Heads up — I just saw a row from AcmeCorp in the console for BetaWorks when switching orgs rapidly. Repro: open metrics, quick-switch, metrics panel shows previous org data. :eyes:

maria: can you paste screenshot/logs?

jamal: link: https://redwood.internal/snap/12345 and console log snippet:

jamal: ```
POST /internal/console/metrics 200
headers: X-Org-ID: 12345 -> 67890; cookie: workspace=67890
response payload: {"org_id": 12345, "metrics": [...] }
```

alex: wow, that looks like a race between prefetch and auth binding. frontend might be prefilling requests with stale cookie/workspace and backend serving cached payload keyed incorrectly.

sasha: is this the prefetched panel codepath (metrics prefetch on hover) or the route-level prefetch we added?

kevin: quick question — does the internal API accept org ID from both header and cookie? if so that's a layering issue. auth should be canonical.

maria: reproduced on staging with ~200ms switch frequency, can confirm.

ops-bot: deploy activity: deploy-frontend-2026-03-01 by maria succeeded (build 9843)

jamal: clearing client route cache makes it disappear; suggests cached KV or server-side cache keyed by cookie instead of auth org.

alex: can someone grep for cache key composition? I'm worried about code paths that use `workspace || header.orgId` instead of authoritative `req.user.orgId`.

alex: propose defensive server-side guard: if `req.user.orgId` != payload org, prefer auth and log telemetry.

irene: i prefer telemetry-first in prod, hard-assert in staging. we don't want 400s for existing clients mid-day.

kevin: telemetry event idea: `console.org_mismatch` with fields {auth_org, payload_org, route, user_id}. cheap and actionable.

sasha: i'll add an integration test that simulates rapid nav and concurrent prefetch to catch this in CI.

maria: rollout plan: 1) backend middleware canonicalize to auth org + emit telemetry; 2) frontend remove dual-sourcing of x-org header; 3) canary 10% for 30m, monitor `console.org_mismatch` and error rates; 4) full rollout.

jamal: UX short-term: show transient banner "Switching orgs — data may be inconsistent for a few seconds" while we have the canary up.

alex: middleware snippet for canonicalization:

alex: ```js
// server middleware
const authOrg = req.user && req.user.orgId;
const payloadOrg = req.headers['x-org-id'] || req.cookies.workspace;
if (payloadOrg && payloadOrg !== authOrg) {
  telemetry.track('console.org_mismatch', { payloadOrg, authOrg, path: req.path });
  // canonicalize to auth org to avoid cross-tenant leaks
  req.headers['x-org-id'] = authOrg;
}
next();
```

kevin: also audit redis/edge cache key prefixes. ensure every cache read uses `tenant:${authOrg}:` not cookie-only key. that will stop stale reads.

maria: created CORE-9876 and assigned to eng-platform; PR target later today (https://redwood.internal/p/CORE-9876).

ops-bot: issue created: CORE-9876 by maria (eng-platform)

sasha: can we add a realtime alert: if `console.org_mismatch` > 0.1% of console requests in 1h -> page #eng-platform and ping incident-console?

irene: yes please. create alert and route to incident-console with runbook.

kevin: +1 on alert. also add a low-severity dashboard showing org_mismatch trend to console SLO dashboard.

maria: will post PR and note in the canary message. :thumbsup:

jamal: thanks all — i'll re-test after canary and report back.

maria: thanks team!
